title: Avengers: Doomsday is 5 weeks away, so I built hexagon README badges. What are you building?
why_read: A lighthearted, low-substance side project generating movie-themed README badges with essentially no technical depth.
analysis: This is a small side project that generates decorative hexagon-shaped GitHub README badges with Avengers movie-themed color schemes, served as SVGs from a Vercel-hosted service. It's a fun, low-effort community engagement post rather than something offering real engineering insight. The post is mostly a prompt asking other users to share their own movie-themed side projects rather than a deep technical writeup.
